Print.description: Write a diagnostic message to the control's console and status line.

LoginMessage.description: Show a message under the sign-in button: 1 = invalid username or password, 2 = badly formatted username, any other value clears it. timeout greater than zero fades the message away after that many milliseconds.

onSignIn.description: An operator pressed Sign in; JSON string of {username, password}.

onLanguageChange.description: An operator chose a language from the dropdown; gives the language code to write back to the Language property.

Language.description: Display language of the control: 'en' or 'ar'. Any other value keeps the last valid one.
